operationName: Ecuador Internal Armed Conflict / Estado de Excepción
heroHeadline: Noboa Decrees New 60-Day State of Emergency and Curfew in Eight Provinces
heroSubtitle: President Daniel Noboa signed Decree 498 on September 15, 2026, declaring a 60-day state of emergency across eight provinces and three cantons, citing 442 intentional homicides between August 16 and September 10. A 00:00–05:00 curfew ran September 17–30 in Guayas, El Oro, Los Ríos and Manabí, the third of 2026, and home inviolability is suspended. Ecuador has recorded Latin America's highest homicide rate for three consecutive years.
